notes.title: 2025-07-20 핫픽스
notes.content: [h1]Patch Notes[/h1][p]July 20, 2025[/p][p][/p][h3]1. Interaction Bug on In-Game HUD[/h3][p]Fixed a bug where interactions did not work properly when hovering over HUD elements (excluding buttons).[/p][p][/p][h3]2. Extended Daytime for Tutorial[/h3][p]Extended the daytime duration on Day 1 to provide more time for the tutorial.[/p][p][/p][h3]3. Unequip Bug[/h3][p]Fixed a bug where equippable items would be unequipped when reacquired after being equipped via pickup or crafting.[/p][p][/p][h3]4. Inventory Not Opening Bug[/h3][p]Fixed a bug where the inventory window would not open properly after placing an object.[/p][p][/p][h3]5. Auto Interaction Disable Bug[/h3][p]Fixed a bug where auto interaction would stop working if the target object died during the interaction.[/p][p][/p][h3]6. Item Crafting Bug[/h3][p]Fixed a bug where crafted items were not correctly added to the inventory.[/p][p][/p][h3]7. Village Generation Algorithm Bug[/h3][p]Fixed a bug where previously placed village objects were not removed when the algorithm determined a new starting point after failing to place enough buildings.[/p]

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where interactions did not work properly when hovering over HUD elements (excluding buttons).

tags.feature: Extended the daytime duration on Day 1 to provide more time for the tutorial.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where equippable items would be unequipped when reacquired after being equipped via pickup or crafting.
Fixed a bug where the inventory window would not open properly after placing an object.
Fixed a bug where auto interaction would stop working if the target object died during the interaction.
Fixed a bug where crafted items were not correctly added to the inventory.
Fixed a bug where previously placed village objects were not removed when the algorithm determined a new starting point after failing to place enough buildings.

notes.title: 2025-07-20 Update
notes.content: [h1]Patch Notes[/h1][p]July 20, 2025[/p][p][/p][h3]1. Main Screen Overhaul[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44565697/99421068b33d6412a2c8a2aa5315697369420bf0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44565697/15f276b75c8d662b48e6c0ad799d87046bd58632.png"][/img][/p][p]The navigation bar has been removed, and the central area now features a magic orb and a magic circle to access Missions and Upgrades, respectively. At the bottom center, the number of remaining chances (lives) is displayed. When hovering over the orb or circle, the name of the active function is shown for better clarity.[/p][p]Remaining lives are visually represented by the number of spirits orbiting the magic orb.[/p][p]You can now access Missions via the magic orb and Upgrades via the magic circle, all while viewing your remaining lives in the center of the screen![/p][p][/p][h3]2. Mouse Locking Feature Added[/h3][p]The mouse cursor is now confined within the game screen and will no longer move outside the window.[/p][p][/p][h3]3. Camera Movement Method Changed[/h3][p]Previously, the camera moved by dragging with the right mouse button.[/p][p]Now, the camera moves automatically when the cursor is placed near the edge of the screen.[/p][p][/p][h3]4. Auto Interaction Enabled by Default[/h3][p]No more endless clicking! Now, a single mouse click will automatically trigger periodic interactions with the target object.[/p][p]Use your time for strategic decisions instead of grinding clicks.[/p][p]As a result, the "Automation" upgrade has been removed from the upgrade tree, and the cost of the attack speed upgrade has been adjusted.[/p][p][/p][h3]5. Hotkey System Overhauled[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44565697/274c8e0a839394dc643b96bf7d85906d396ceac9.png"][/img][/p][p]The previous hotkeys used to toggle the inventory and crafting windows have been replaced.[/p][p]Now, in the main screen, the [b]ESC[/b] key opens and closes the menu, and also closes the mission and upgrade windows.[/p][p]In-game, [b]ESC[/b] still opens and closes the menu, while [b]I[/b] opens the inventory and [b]C[/b] opens the crafting window.[/p][p]You can now open a new window without closing the others first.[/p][p][/p][h3]6. Tutorial Added[/h3][p]\[Main Screen Tutorial][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44565697/536411c2452e5309dff1edd8635d46d73f04c527.png"][/img][/p][p]\[In-game Screen Tutorial][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44565697/d965e174893a06bb6f8bd4c471ba4ef6b3f78603.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44565697/4e21fe23615f50a2a2199f9930ec4190bbf9654c.png"][/img][/p][p]To help new players, the divine agent now guides them through tutorials on both the main screen and in-game.[/p][p]The tutorial explains the screen layout and how to play.[/p][p]Press [b]Spacebar[/b] or click the dialogue box to proceed, and press [b]ESC[/b] to skip.[/p][p][/p][h3]7. Bug Fix: Game Freeze on Entering Stage[/h3][p]Fixed a bug where the game would freeze during stage generation if it failed to place a sufficient number of building objects, causing an infinite loop.[/p]

tags.feature: The navigation bar has been removed, and the central area now features a magic orb and a magic circle to access Missions and Upgrades, respectively. At the bottom center, the number of remaining chances (lives) is displayed. When hovering over the orb or circle, the name of the active function is shown for better clarity.
You can now access Missions via the magic orb and Upgrades via the magic circle, all while viewing your remaining lives in the center of the screen!
The mouse cursor is now confined within the game screen and will no longer move outside the window.
Now, the camera moves automatically when the cursor is placed near the edge of the screen.
No more endless clicking! Now, a single mouse click will automatically trigger periodic interactions with the target object.

tags.balance_change: As a result, the "Automation" upgrade has been removed from the upgrade tree, and the cost of the attack speed upgrade has been adjusted.

tags.feature: The previous hotkeys used to toggle the inventory and crafting windows have been replaced.
Now, in the main screen, the [b]ESC[/b] key opens and closes the menu, and also closes the mission and upgrade windows.
In-game, [b]ESC[/b] still opens and closes the menu, while [b]I[/b] opens the inventory and [b]C[/b] opens the crafting window.
You can now open a new window without closing the others first.
To help new players, the divine agent now guides them through tutorials on both the main screen and in-game.
The tutorial explains the screen layout and how to play.
Press [b]Spacebar[/b] or click the dialogue box to proceed, and press [b]ESC[/b] to skip.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the game would freeze during stage generation if it failed to place a sufficient number of building objects, causing an infinite loop.

notes.title: 2025-07-16 Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p]July 16, 2025[/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. Graphics Improvements[/b][/h3][p]The following graphics have been improved:[/p][list][*][p][b]Terrain[/b]: Dirt and water tile images[/p][/*][*][p][b]Some Field Objects[/b]: Village buildings, trees, and rocks[/p][/*][*][p][b]Some Item Icons[/b]: Stone, iron, and iron axe icons[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]2. Visibility Improvements[/b][/h3][p]Fixed an issue where the values (such as health) of field objects were not visible when hovered with the mouse if they were obscured.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Title Screen Animation Added[/b][/h3][p]The divine agent, who appears when the protagonist first opens their eyes, has been added to the center of the title screen to match the story. Fog has also been added to enhance depth and atmosphere.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. In-Game Hotkeys Added[/b][/h3][p]Hotkeys have been added to toggle UI windows:
Press [b]I[/b] to open/close the inventory, [b]C[/b] for the crafting window, and [b]ESC[/b] for the menu.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]5. Intro Scene Added[/b][/h3][p]To enhance immersion at the start of the game, the divine agent’s voice is now shown as text. Press [b]Spacebar[/b] to proceed or [b]ESC[/b] to skip.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]6. New Monster Added[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Slime[/b]
Description: A small jelly-like creature that slowly moves and attacks.
Stats:[/p][list][*][p]HP: 3[/p][/*][*][p]Attack: 1[/p][/*][*][p]Drop Items: Viewable in-game[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]7. Village Generation Algorithm Updated[/b][/h3][p]The building placement algorithm at the start of a stage has been changed.
Previously, buildings were placed completely at random. Now, buildings are placed around a central point to form a more natural village layout.[/p]

notes.title: 2025-07-13 Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p]July 13, 2025[/p][p][/p][h3]1. UI Interaction Improvements[/h3][p]Fixed an issue where field objects could be unintentionally affected when using the mouse over UI elements.[/p][p][/p][h3]2. Visibility Improvements[/h3][p]The background color has been changed from black to dark gray to help distinguish the game map from the background more clearly.[/p][p][/p][h3]3. Settings Menu[/h3][p]Added a settings button to both the main menu and the in-game menu.
You can now adjust sound settings and change the language during gameplay![/p][p][/p][h3]4. Construction System Implemented[/h3][p]A system has been added that allows players to place objects on the field.
When selecting a buildable item from the inventory, the game enters construction mode, allowing placement of the object on the field.
A [b]green outline[/b] indicates the object can be placed, while a [b]red outline[/b] indicates it cannot.
Pressing the [b]ESC[/b] key while in construction mode will cancel it and return to interaction mode.[/p][p][/p][p]The following construction items have been added: [i]Campfire[/i], [i]Wall[/i], [i]Altar of Fire[/i], [i]Altar of Lightning[/i].[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Campfire[/b]
[i]Description:[/i] Illuminates the area around it for a limited time. Interacting with it consumes 1 wood to extend its duration.
[i]Craftable:[/i] Yes
[i]Materials:[/i] 20 Wood, 10 Stone[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Wall[/b]
[i]Description:[/i] A durable obstacle. Interacting with it consumes 1 stone to increase its durability.
[i]Craftable:[/i] Yes
[i]Materials:[/i] 50 Stone[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Altar of Fire[/b]
[i]Description:[/i] An altar that launches flames at nearby enemies. Interacting with it consumes wood to increase its durability.
At certain durability levels, its damage, firing speed, and projectile speed increase.
[i]Craftable:[/i] Yes
[i]Materials:[/i] Viewable in-game[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Altar of Lightning[/b]
[i]Description:[/i] An altar that attacks nearby enemies with lightning. Interacting with it consumes wood to increase its durability.
At certain durability levels, its damage, firing speed, and casting speed increase.
[i]Craftable:[/i] Yes
[i]Materials:[/i] Viewable in-game[/p][p][/p][h3]5. Terrain Generation Improvements[/h3][p]Previously, water tiles were placed randomly to create terrain.
Now, terrain elevation is generated using Perlin noise, and land and sea are determined based on the elevation, resulting in more natural terrain.[/p][p][/p][h3]6. Field Object Spawn Logic Added[/h3][p]In addition to spawning objects based on day/night cycles and time segments,
a new system has been added to always generate resource objects in the field.
Now the field will always contain a sufficient number of resource objects.[/p][p][/p][h3]7. UI Hidden After Stage Ends[/h3][p]Fixed an issue where the inventory and item info windows remained open after a stage ended.[/p][p][/p][h3]8. Sound Settings Saved[/h3][p]Your sound settings are now saved and will be automatically loaded the next time you launch the game.[/p]

notes.title: 2025-07-07 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1][p]July 7, 2025[/p][p][/p][h3]1. In-Game Difficulty Adjustments[/h3][p]We have adjusted the difficulty level for each stage as follows:[/p][p][b]Stage 1[/b][/p][p]Starts off easy but gradually becomes more difficult. Portals that spawn monsters will begin to appear. [b]Difficulty:[/b] Low → Low-Mid
[b]Monsters:[/b] Goblin, Blue Portal, Goblin Warrior[/p][p][/p][p][b]Stage 2[/b]
Same types of monsters appear, but stronger versions and greater numbers are introduced.
[b]Difficulty:[/b] Low-Mid → Mid
[b]Monsters:[/b] Goblin, Goblin Warrior, Blue Portal, Red Portal[/p][p][/p][p][b]Stage 3[/b]
Even stronger monsters appear, and the Goblin Shaman makes its first appearance.
[b]Difficulty:[/b] Mid → Mid-High
[b]Monsters:[/b] Goblin, Goblin Warrior, Goblin Shaman, Red Portal, Purple Portal[/p][p][/p][h3]2. Critical Hit Interaction System Implemented[/h3][p]Critical hits are now applied during interactions based on your critical hit chance.
A critical interaction deals [b]double[/b] the amount of a normal interaction by default.[/p][p][/p][h3]3. Interaction Automation System Implemented[/h3][p]After acquiring the [i]Interaction Automation[/i] upgrade, holding down the left mouse button will repeatedly perform interactions until the button is released.
If you acquire the [i]Automation Speed[/i] upgrade, the speed of automated interactions will increase.[/p][p][/p][h3]4. New Upgrade Nodes Added[/h3][p]The following upgrade options have been added:[/p][list][*][p]Attack Power Increase: Lv. 6–10[/p][/*][*][p]Critical Hit Chance Increase: Lv. 1–5[/p][/*][*][p]Critical Hit Damage Increase: Lv. 1–3[/p][/*][*][p]Recovery Rate Increase: Lv. 1–3[/p][/*][*][p]Interaction Automation: Lv. 1[/p][/*][*][p]Automation Speed: Lv. 1–5[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]5. Opportunity Count Adjustment[/h3][p]The number of [b]opportunities[/b] given at the start of the game to attempt missions has been increased from 3 to 5.[/p]

tags.balance_change: Starts off easy but gradually becomes more difficult. Portals that spawn monsters will begin to appear. [b]Difficulty:[/b] Low → Low-Mid

Even stronger monsters appear, and the Goblin Shaman makes its first appearance. [b]Difficulty:[/b] Mid → Mid-High

After acquiring the [i]Interaction Automation[/i] upgrade, holding down the left mouse button will repeatedly perform interactions until the button is released. If you acquire the [i]Automation Speed[/i] upgrade, the speed of automated interactions will increase.

Critical Hit Chance Increase: Lv. 1–5
Critical Hit Damage Increase: Lv. 1–3
Recovery Rate Increase: Lv. 1–3

notes.title: 2025-06-27 Update
notes.content: [h1]Patch Notes[/h1][p]June 27, 2025[/p][p][/p][h3]1. Game engine changed[/h3][p]Changed from a self-built engine to a Unity engine.[/p][p][/p][h3]2. Upgrade feature added[/h3][p]You can now upgrade player's abilities on the Upgrade tab on the main view.[/p][p][/p][h3]3. Simple animations applied[/h3][p]added an animation of monsters and an animation that shakes when interacting with other objects to give it a liveliness.[/p][p][/p][h3]4. In-game time system added[/h3][p]added time system to divide the day and night, and to create objects differently during the day and night.[/p][p][/p][h3]5. BGM added[/h3][p]added background music.[/p]
